Report §§7.3.2–7.3.6. GPIO4/5 I2C; DS1302 GPIO6/7/14; ST7789 GPIO8–12; SD GPIO21/40/41/42; RGB GPIO16/17/18; buzzer GPIO15. Recorded carrier ERC, DRC, unrouted and parity violations: zero. HR estimates ranged 42–187 bpm without a reference instrument. Maximum surface-to-ambient difference 0.84°C did not meet 1.5°C warm-target rule. Proposed LCD/DS3231 changed to ST7789/DS1302.

Objective 4: Performance evaluation
NEOGUARD   /   GROUP D
IMPLEMENTATION
RECORDED EVIDENCE
Split 480 synthetic sessions into 288 training, 96 validation and 96 test sessions.
Evaluated 19,272 held-out rows using a validation-selected threshold.
Compared event detection, lead time and warning burden with threshold-only detection.
93.77% precision
81.77% recall
0.9748 ROC-AUC
Ranking performance, not 97.48% accuracy
Partly achieved. Clinical accuracy, real-world alert timing and patient outcomes remain unestablished.

Report §7.6. Confusion matrix: TP 4395, TN 13605, FP 292, FN 980. 19 more events detected at onset. 89.8% versus 51.0% event sensitivity, 38.8 percentage point difference. Synthetic scenario labels are not verified neonatal outcomes. Median lead 107.5 seconds; warning episodes/hour 1.4197 versus 0.7472.
